description: youtube: Channel Videos. GET /v1/youtube/channel-videos. Provide one of: channelId, handle. Get paginated videos from a YouTube channel by channelId or handle. Paid-promotion filtering is not supported; use /v1/youtube/video and its isPaidPromotion field for each video's status. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

continuationToken.description: Use continuationToken from the previous response to get the next page.

includeExtras.description: Include like/comment counts and descriptions. Increases errors and may be deprecated; use /v1/youtube/video for full details.
